group_definition.used188: Fixed proxy row IDs with at least one sample hard pair/triple ancestor choice during actual epoch300.
group_definition.boundary297: Fixed epoch300 proxy IDs: eligible=true, clean-eval mapped coordinate radius >= .99899, and no actual epoch300 sample hard pair/triple ancestor choice.

method.signed_radial_statistic: For each fixed proxy, average g dot unit(position) over the same16 frozen clean-eval batches; group means, sign counts and scalar L2 are computed from these per-proxy averages.
method.norm_statistic: For each fixed proxy, average FP32 gradient vector norm over16 batches, then average those values over the group; this is NOT the norm of the mean gradient vector.
method.sign_semantics: Positive radial partial derivative means ordinary Euclidean gradient descent tends inward; negative means outward. These are not inherited AdamW displacements.
method.proxy_parameterization: Euclidean tangent parameters mapped by expmap0 with numerical coordinate-radius safety projection .999; at saturation tangent radial derivatives are nearly flat.

limitations: Existing source diagnostics are frozen clean-eval FP32 CPU replay, without training augmentation, backbone forward, training BN or original CUDA Gumbel replay.
Cohorts are fixed by epoch300 identities; they are not reselected separately at each source epoch.

Ball-space gradients are pre-map partial derivatives; tangent-space gradients include expmap0 and numerical projection. Large ball radial derivatives can coexist with negligible tangent radial derivatives.
Signs of near-zero FP32 tangent radial residuals do not identify a reliable radial force.
Reported FP32 vector norm zero can result from underflow; sample gradients around1e-24 in ball space and1e-34 in tangent space are numerically negligible, not mathematically proven exactly zero.
No new actual optimizer displacement was measured; inherited AdamW moments, coordinate preconditioning and weight decay can produce motion different from plain gradient descent.
e99/e200/e300 snapshots cannot identify which loss caused the initial boundary overshoot after epoch20.
Previously failed100-step proxy-only endpoint comparison remains excluded; this join uses only completed zero-update16-batch summaries.
